request.query: B2B software companies with fast-growing sales teams (20-300 reps) that would buy an AI meeting-capture and CRM tool
additionalQueries: SaaS companies hiring account executives and SDRs 2026 mid-market
series B and C software companies scaling go-to-market teams
companies with large inside sales teams that run many customer calls per week
request.systemPrompt:
Prospecting for the source company. Source: Dial8 (dial8.ai): AI workspace for sales teams — records and transcribes customer meetings, extracts actions and decisions, keeps a CRM with web enrichment and email sequences. $99 per seat.
Return UP TO 20 DISTINCT companies, one entry per company, each with its primary website domain. Skip anything without a clear domain. NEVER include any of these already-known domains: quillfort.ai, quoteleaf.com, tallyhire.com, roamwise.ai, replyforge.com, forecastly.com, sequencely.io, cadenceloop.com, leadvault.io, contactgrid.com, hubspot.com, chimewell.io.
